name: Current unbalance / negative sequence
summary: A current phase-balance or reverse-phase function used in documented protection applications.
description: Device function number 46 is associated with reverse-phase or phase-balance current protection. Manufacturer implementations often use negative-sequence or current-unbalance quantities. The implementation, measurement basis and protected equipment must be identified in the protection documentation.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the phase-current measurements used by the device.
Confirm the manufacturer name and implementation rather than relying only on the number.
drawingChecklist: Identify the protected machine or circuit.
Link the selected relay function documentation.
distinction: Current unbalance and voltage phase-sequence or balance functions use different measured quantities. Identify the element explicitly.
